title: Single Post Curved Cord And Suspended Ball Tetherball
description: One newly authored complete static single-post tetherball display. A broad low circular base has an integral raised socket and full flat sole. One whole tall capped cylindrical mast carries a true thick bored side eye near its top. One unbroken finite-thickness cord follows a fixed outward descending curve from that rooted eye into one whole suspended faceted ball. The ball has constant solid-colour face sectors, not an applied seam texture or a hollow inflation simulation. Five complete newly authored closed meshes; no old skittles-game tray, arm, pins, speed-bag deck, or volleyball sleeves reused. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, native metres/Z up, horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One original decorative model, zero scenes. The curve and ball are a frozen sculptural pose, not a gravity, tension, pendulum or wrapping simulation. No playable rules, installation dimensions, ball performance, anti-tip stability, load capacity, manufacture, sports suitability or safety claim; no people or surrounding court.
